requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor identifies the original mismatch, and the patch confirms it: `moldea/moldea.yaml` changed from `name: find_order` to `name: lookup_order`, while `src/agent.ts` registers `tools: { lookup_order: lookupOrderTool }`.

The current manifest declares `name: lookup_order`. Git status and diff show `moldea/moldea.yaml` as the only changed path and only this name correction. Deterministic validation reports `valid`, zero failures, and passing typecheck.

The current manifest exactly binds `supportAgent`, `loadSupportInstruction`, `SupportOutputSchema`, `lookupOrder`, `lookupOrderTool`, `LookupOrderInputSchema`, and `LookupOrderOutputSchema` to their existing source declarations. Workspace hashes show all source and instruction files unchanged, and deterministic inspection, validation, and typechecking all pass.

`src/support-agent.ts` calls `generateText(buildRequest(prompt))`, and `buildRequest` supplies `prepareStep` that may replace instructions. The runtime guidance and manifest warning explicitly explain that this indirect form prevents static proof of the effective instructions.

`moldea/moldea.yaml` references the sole file `moldea/runtimes/vercel-ai-sdk.md`, and that file accurately describes the repository wrapper without provider claims. However, the file does not describe the supported direct `generateText({ ... })` object-literal alternative; that detail appears only in the manifest warning.

The manifest adds an agent-level warning named `static-instruction-boundary`, identifies `/src/support-agent.ts`, explains the static-analysis limitation, and gives the concrete resolution of migrating to direct `generateText({ ... })` with focused runtime coverage. Deterministic validation passed.

The Git diff adds only the guidance reference and unresolved warning. It adds no instruction-loader, schema, tool, provider, model, routing, handoff, or subagent relationship, and the existing source and bindings remain unchanged.
